newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish pdt to attend Perry farewell in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Polish pdt to attend Perry farewell in Britain.

text.p: Poland's President Aleksander Kwasniewski will pay a one-day working visit to Britain on Thursday to attend a farewell for outgoing U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry, Kwasniewski's office said.

"At the invitation of British Defence Minister Michael Portillo, the president will take part in bidding farewell to former U.S. defence secretary William Perry in Portsmouth," the office said in a statement on Tuesday.

Kwasniewski's spokesman Antoni Styrczula said top NATO officials would attend a dinner for Perry, and the president would use the opportunity of the trip for talks on Poland's planned future membership of the Western defence alliance.
Poland is widely expected to be among the first former Soviet-bloc states to be invited this year to open talks on joining NATO and to enter in 1999, along with the Czech Republic and Hungary.
